A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same UncertainSAM work. The complete main text, equations, figures, tables and appendices are readable and reliably matched; all seven appendix pages are visually identical.

before.justification: v1 reports original USAM evaluations on five segmentation datasets, token ablations, runtime measurements, corruption tests and additional empirical analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains the original experimental results in Sections 4.2–4.6 and the appendix tables and qualitative examples. These retained results qualify as original empirical outcomes.

M1.justification: The Bayesian approximations and USAM procedure remain unchanged, including concatenated mask/IoU tokens, MLP architecture, mean-squared-error objectives and inference-time uncertainty estimates in Sections 3.1–3.2.

E1.justification: Both versions use DAVIS, ADE20k, MOSE, COCO and SA-V with the same model-selection, prompt-refinement, task-supervision and segmentation-correction scenarios. Appendix transfer evaluations and image-corruption coverage are also unchanged.

E2.justification: SamScore, mask entropy and the task-specific Bayesian comparators retain the same membership in corresponding experiments in Tables 1–4 and 11–14. The new Kirchhof citation introduces no evaluated comparator.

E3.justification: Data splits, training/search settings, SAM model sizes, prompt and augmentation sampling, and mIoU/AUC evaluation procedures are unchanged. Correcting Table 7's direction arrow does not change its runtime metric or measurement protocol.

E4.justification: The token ablation in Table 6, model-size and corruption analyses in Tables 9–10, correlation analyses, transfer evaluations and qualitative examples are retained without changes.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point estimates and Pearson correlations. Neither introduces repeated-run counts, seed disclosures, confidence intervals, significance tests or another statistical uncertainty-reporting procedure.

E6.justification: Reported scores, runtimes, correlations, rankings and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, COCO USAML remains 90.01% relative AUC in Table 4; Table 7 changes only its direction indicator.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(11), mathematical assumptions and Bayesian approximations remain unchanged, including Appendix A. The new underspecification footnote provides conceptual commentary without adding or revising a formal definition, derivation or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about decomposing SAM uncertainty, constructing a Bayesian approximation and providing efficient USAM estimates with superior or comparable performance.

C2.justification: v1 already acknowledges debate over separating aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty in Section 2.2. v4 adds a specific interpretive connection between Equation (2) and underspecification, applying the newly cited critique to this paper in footnote 2. Empirical interpretations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility information remains unchanged: MLP specifications, optimization settings, Appendix A sampling details, Table 8 hyperparameter results, RTX3050 Ti runtime hardware, and code/pretrained-model access information.

R1.justification: v4 adds Kirchhof et al. (2025), Position: Uncertainty quantification needs reassessment for large language model agents, and relates its underspecification concept to Equation (2). The remaining citations and research positioning are retained.

P1.justification: v4 adds a short footnote and updates the affiliation to include L3S. The main prose, terminology, section order and narrative remain substantially unchanged; passages shift through routine reflow.

P2.justification: Table 7 corrects its seconds-per-iteration arrow from upward to downward. The added footnote and reference produce modest layout reflow, including moving Equation (7) from page 4 to page 5. Figures and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: v4 corrects Table 7's misleading runtime direction indicator and adds a specific conceptual connection between Equation (2) and underspecification. These provide limited gains in presentation accuracy and research context. The method, empirical evidence and appendices remain unchanged, so the overall improvement is small.
